title: rosa obtusifolia var. obornyana
intro: Rosa obtusifolia var. obornyana, commonly known as the Korean rose, is a plant species in the rose family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and menstrual disorders. The health benefits of Rosa obtusifolia var. obornyana are attributed to its ability to reduce stress and promote relaxation, as well as its antispasmodic, sedative, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
